text: {"sql": "SELECT i.kind AS incident_category, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, ROUND(AVG(w.temperature_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c FROM sf_ops.incidents i JOIN sf_plant.weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('HOUR', i.ts) = w.ts GROUP BY i.kind ORDER BY incident_count DESC", "columns": ["incident_category", "incident_count", "avg_outdoor_temp_c"], "purpose": "Compare average outdoor temperature at machine overheat incidents versus all incident kinds"}

data.sql: SELECT i.kind AS incident_category, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, ROUND(AVG(w.temperature_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c FROM sf_ops.incidents i JOIN sf_plant.weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('HOUR', i.ts) = w.ts GROUP BY i.kind ORDER BY incident_count DESC
